signInFailedHint: Signing in with Microsoft Teams did not work. Please reload the tab. If it keeps failing, contact your organisation's administrators.
invitationCodeIntro: You are signed in as {email}. This server also requires an invitation code before an account can be created.
invitationCodeRejected: This invitation code is not valid.
signInFailedNotInTeams: This page is not running inside Microsoft Teams. It is meant to be opened as a Teams tab — in a browser, please use the normal sign-in.
signInFailedNoToken: Microsoft Teams did not issue a token for this app. That is almost always the app registration: a missing Application ID URI, the "access_as_user" scope, the pre-authorized Teams clients, or consent that was never granted.
signInFailedExchange: The server rejected the sign-in. Details are in the server log.
